raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W4W) Moderately away from the widest draw, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘普通，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W4W) Average to begin, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out 550M, no daylight early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, finished off well to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W4W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內疊。五百五十米處向外移出。直路初未能望空。趨近二百米處時望空。衝刺良佳，過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, raced keenly, made some ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。搶口。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W2W) Sat worse than midfield, traveled smoothly, responded fairly well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走勢暢順。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked pace, chased leaders from top of home straight, stayed on well, gradually closing down winner final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自直路初起追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，最後一百米逐漸追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Switched off to race at the rear of the field over 10Ls back middle stages, steadied 300M when commencing to finish off the race, had to change lane but the final effort was just fair.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 留居後列。中段落後逾十個馬位。三百米處在開始衝刺之際收慢。末段須轉換跑線，但衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Commenced well, tracked leaders on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened and eased final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱，收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after passing 350M, hit the front 200M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。跑過三百五十米處後向外移出。二百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked pace, ridden and made effort 400m out, no extra and lost ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。受催策，四百米處發力。最後二百米再無餘力，失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, slightly improved after passing 600M, 2nd turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過六百米處後略為推進。入直路時居第二位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, headed 250M, kept on well until approaching 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。二百五十米處被超越，保持佳勢直至趨近五十米處。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, challenged the leader 600M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居前列，走第二疊。六百米處挑戰領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped well from a tricky gate, raced prominently on the outside early, positioned 2 wide better than midfield after passing 900M, 2-1/2Ls back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，早段居前列，走外疊。跑過九百米處後居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W4W5W) Sat midfield, raced very wide, minor response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W4W5W) 居中間位置，走大外疊。對催策略有反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, faded top of the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路初力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, unable to quicken 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處未能加速。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Led, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 領先，其後直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure to hold position 700m out, bumped and lost balance 250m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處在催策下保持位置。二百五十米處與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace, three wide throughout, one paced under pressure final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，沿途走第三疊。最後三百米在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat towards rear, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居後列。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Not hurried on jumping from draw 1, settled in second half of the field, ran on only fairly in the straight. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘，未受催策，居後半馬群中。直路上走勢僅屬一般。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) From draw 1 given a patient ride in a rearward spot, had some work to do top of the straight, lacked a turn of foot and couldn't launch a serious challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。直路初仍落後甚遠。未能加速以展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Settled well behind and waited with, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, produced strong late finish between runners inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 遙居於後，留力候上。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後二百米在馬匹之間衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W3W) Taken back from gate 12, raced towards rear on the inside, 2 wide on turn, no clear run early in straight, made good progress thereafter to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走第二疊。直路初未能望空。其後追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, commenced move 500M, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。五百米處開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield, minor progress made when asked (See incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置。在催策下略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, wide into home straight, kept going but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W3W) Sat just behind the leaders, travelled nicely at the top of the Straight, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路初走勢良佳，在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield, traveled reasonably well, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢不俗。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Taken back from gate 10, raced at rear throughout, never a factor. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自第十檔出閘後留後，沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。直路早段未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Wide in mid-field, under pressure 500m out, soon lost place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。五百米處受催策。瞬即失位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W5W) Mid-field, raced wide, forced wider final bend, soon lost place and well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎被迫走更外疊。瞬即失位，所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W4W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, crowded top of the Straight, gave ground thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W4W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路初受擠迫，其後墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W3W5W) Sat handy, angled out rounding the Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W3W5W) 居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) In touch with leaders, ridden to hold position from halfway, soon weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自半程起受催策以保持位置。直路上瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 3 wide behind midfield, slightly improved on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎略為推進。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Away with them, raced in midfield on the inside, peaked on turn, weakened gradually in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎未能再增速。直路上逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled in front of midfield, not much response when asked, no contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置。對催策無甚反應。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride near last 8-9Ls off the pace, had big task in hand top of straight, failed to respond and finished tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居接近包尾位置，留力候上，落後領放馬八至九個馬位。直路初落後甚遠。末段對催策毫無反應，大敗而回。（表現難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Mid-field, had to wait for run briefly entering home straight headway between horses, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置。入直路時一度須等待空位出現，在馬匹之間追前。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Raced behind midfield on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, unable to quicken under pressure 300m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處在催策下未能增速。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden along 750m out to maintain position, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。七百五十米處受催策以保持位置。入直路時走勢暢順。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 350M, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Hampered at start, waited with in rear, keen early, driven along 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步時受阻礙，居後列，留力候上。早段搶口。四百米處受催策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Raced close up, effort early in home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路初發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W2W2W) Sat on pace, slightly weakened passing the 150M, closed off okay (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居前列。跑過一百五十米處時略為轉弱。衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along 500m out to chase leader, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。五百米處受推策，追趕領放馬。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, there to turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。直路彎前居相同位置，走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Average to begin, positioned 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, carried wider turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘一般，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時被帶出較外疊。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Moderately away, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace until approaching final 50M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。保持同速直至趨近最後五十米，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Began awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, hung out in the home turn, one pace when asked. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路彎外閃。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W2W2W4W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer after entering the back straight, 4Ls back turning in, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W2W2W4W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。進入對面直路後略為追近。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路早段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the outside, commenced move 800M, took the lead approaching 700M, headed 500M, kept on well until final 100M, stayed on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走外疊。八百米處開始上前。趨近七百米處時取得領先。五百米處被超越。保持佳勢直至最後一百米。末段保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W2W2W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide approaching 700M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內疊。趨近七百米處時走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W3W3W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 750M, 3 lengths or so back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。自七百五十米處起走第三疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上未能以勁勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 wide after entering the back straight, made contact 900M, hard ridden approaching 550M, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。進入對面直路後走第三疊。九百米處與他駒互相觸碰。趨近五百五十米處時受力策。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W2W4W) Held up last, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well early in home straight to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W2W4W) 留居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路早段以佳勢追前，二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W4W) Moderately away, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 出閘普通，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W2W3W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide after entering the back straight, wider turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W2W3W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。進入對面直路後走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W3W3W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced very wide throughout, improved to track pace out wide without cover 1500m out, effort 500m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W3W3W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，沿途走大外疊。千五米處上前跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W4W) Began only fairly from a wide draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W4W) 自外檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W1W2W) Commenced well, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W1W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 wide from 600M, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, made some progress final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。自六百米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路初未能望空。最後二百米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off strongly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。衝刺強勁，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W4W) Slowly away, taken back to race at tail, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W4W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away and lost four lengths, always well in rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，落後四個馬位。全程遙居於後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W2W3W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out 1100M, slightly improved in the middle stages, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。千一米處向外移出，中段略為推進。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位，直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (3W2W1W) Tracked leaders, tight for room 350m out, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(3W2W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百五十米處受緊迫。直路初受催策。保持走勢，但未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, nothing extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled okay, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W1W) 居前列。走勢不俗。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Involved in early battle for lead, chased leader until no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 早段爭奪領先。追趕領放馬，直至最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, pushed along final bend to chase leaders, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎受推策，追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，但未能與頭馬抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置﹐走第二疊。未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Out with rest, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well but unable to hold off the first few close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。保持佳勢，但末段未能抗衡首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Shifted out at start and bumped, sent forward to race prominently, shared lead turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，被碰撞，受催策上前，居前列。入直路時並排領先。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to take the lead but trapped 4 wide, shared lead with rivals turning in, peaked and headed early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放，但走第四疊。入直路時與對手並排領先。直路早段未能再加速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Led from pole position, headed final 100M, unable to find an extra gear when being challenged.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自最內檔出閘後領放。最後一百米被超越。受挑戰時未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Raced 3 wide no cover, kept on only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 走第三疊，沒有遮擋。僅能保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, checked briefly halfway and unable to hold position, left behind in rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。半程時一度勒避，未能保持位置。最後二百米被拋離，居後列過終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderate start, recovered swiftly between runners to take up running over 950M out setting a smart pace on home bend, led until tiring 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，其後在馬匹之間迅速恢復走勢，九百五十米處取得領先。直路彎以快步速領放。保持領先直至三百米處呈現疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickened to lead 250m out, headed by winner 50m out, weakened quickly close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領放馬。二百五十米處加速取得領先。五十米處被頭馬超越。接近終點時迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length on turn, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。直路彎領先一個馬位。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Missed the start, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, very wide turning in, made some headway in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 漏閘，居後列，走外疊。中段略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually close home, finished 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領先。入直路時領先一個半馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Showed speed to lead, pressed in front, headed by winner 300m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 展現前速以領放，受追迫。三百米處被頭馬超越，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Crowded and bumped at start, held up last, still in last place into home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，留居包尾位置。入直路時仍居最後一位。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, mid division, ridden along to maintain position halfway out, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置。半程時受催策以保持位置。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in second half of the field, 7Ls to make up 400M but failed to finish off.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居後半馬群中。四百米處落後七個馬位，但末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Lacked early pace, ridden to soon recover to 7th some 6L back on rail in back straight, tightened and lost a stride 500M out, ran home one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 缺乏前速。受催策，瞬即恢復走勢。對面直路上居第七位，落後約六個馬位，走內欄。五百米處受緊迫，失去步韻。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Lacked pace early and soon dropped to rear despite ridden early, remained well behind into straight, saved ground home turn, produced good late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 早段欠缺前速，儘管受催策，但瞬即墮居後列。入直路時仍落後甚遠。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off strongly, just beaten by a nose.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。衝刺強勁，僅以馬鼻位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W5W) Four wide in rear without cover, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W5W) 居後列，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Moderately away from gate 8, raced prominently on the outside, 1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自第八檔出閘普通，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, stayed on for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, travelled well to turn, challenged the leader after turning in, hit the front 100M, kept on well to the line and scored.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前走勢良佳。入直路後挑戰領放馬。一百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 3 wide in midfield, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走第三疊，沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders in three wide, pushed along wide in home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹，走第三疊。直路上受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, struggled to maintain position from 600m out, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自六百米處起難以保持位置，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to challenge 300m out, tended to edge right, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放兩駒。三百米處在催策下展開挑戰，傾向內閃。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。未能望空直至三百米處。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, gave ground final 200M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。最後二百米墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield, 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began smartly from the widest draw, raced prominently, 3 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Dispute lead, weakened final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;爭奪領先。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind the lead on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace, weakened at the top of the Straight, closed off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列。直路初轉弱。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide near midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W1W) Took up running just before the 1000M bend, obtained rails run over 800M out, led until headed after straightening, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W1W) 就在一千米處彎位前取得領先。八百米處移入內欄。保持領先，直至入直路後被超越，迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Pressed in front, unable to hold position by halfway and dropped away quickly, eased when detached 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;在領放下受追迫。半程前未能保持位置。其後迅速墮退。二百米處被拋離，收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Commenced well, raced behind midfield on the outside, 4-1/2L back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Led on the rail, traveled okay, little response in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 沿欄領放，走勢尚可。直路上對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden hard to lead, traveled fairly, weakened notably in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 在力策下取得領先，走勢一般。直路上顯著轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 600m out, one paced under pressure, impeded 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自六百米處起難以保持位置。在催策下保持同速。一百米處受阻礙。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, shared lead turning in, peaked 200M, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。入直路時並排領先。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier, obtained rails run in front 1000M out setting a steady pace, kicked some 2L clear on straightening but unable to sustain effort inside final 100M and collared close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入內欄，一千米處取得領先，以平穩步速領放。入直路時加速帶離約兩個馬位，但最後一百米後勁不繼，接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leader, under pressure to chase leader 450m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W2W2W) 出閘後受催策，跟隨領放馬。四百五十米處在催策下追趕領放馬。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W4W) Jumped cleanly, sat on pace 2 wide, finished off well to take 3rd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W4W) 出閘俐落，居前列，走第二疊。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Began well, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Sat handy 2 wide, failed to quicken in the straight. (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Fast into stride, raced prominently on the inside, allowed the rival to cross near 500M, a length or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展步迅速，居前列，走內疊。接近五百米處時讓對手過頭，入直路時落後約一個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure to hold position 800m out, ran on well in home straight but always held by winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。八百米處在催策下保持位置。直路上以佳勢上前，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in front of midfield, minor progress made, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置。略為上前。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Showed great speed to lead, kicked 400m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;展現甚快前速，取得領先。四百米處加速。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide better than midfield, difficult to settle in the early and middle stages, 2-1/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。早段及中段難以穩定走勢。入直路時落後二又四分一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, raced keenly throughout, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。沿途搶口。直路上迅速墮退，遙遙落後時收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Began fast and dictated things in front, run peaked 150m out and knocked up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，帶頭。一百五十米處未能再增速。迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Jumped awkwardly settling in rear of midfield in 8th or 7th fought on steadily in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後的第七或第八位。直路上持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, no clear run top of the Straight, ran on okay once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空，望空後走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead in the middle stages, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner in the closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。中段輕鬆帶頭。直路上保持佳勢，但末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, there to turn, kept on same pace until no clear run final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。保持同速，直至最後五十米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (5W4W) Sat 4 wide no cover midfield, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(5W4W) 居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 3/4L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後一百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Crowded start, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, peaked on run 500M, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。五百米處未能再增速。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Prominent early, tracking leaders halfway, struggling to hold position final bend, soon weakened.
(Sustained a small abrasion to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small abrasion to its right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W2W2W) 早段居前列，半程時跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎難以保持位置，瞬即轉弱。
（右前腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to maintain position on bend, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Shifted out at start, raced 3 wide better than midfield early, 2 wide on turn, took the lead 250M, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，早段居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路彎走第二疊。二百五十米處取得領先。趨近二百米處時未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat handy, traveled fairly, could not be ridden out when positioned close to heels.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢一般。末段在靠近他駒的後蹄時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, tracked leaders, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久與他駒互相觸碰，跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Showed good speed to across, headed 250m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，切入內疊。二百五十米處被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, peaked on run near 400M, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。接近四百米處時未能再增速。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout, brief headway from rear 200m out, soon flattened out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 沿途走大外疊。二百米處自後列一度追前，瞬即洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, wider turning in, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on strongly to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走更外疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百五十米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Made contact shortly after start, raced better than midfield, 2 away from the stands' rail, dropped to midfield in the middle stages, hard ridden after passing 400M but showed no response, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走外欄第三疊。中段墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處後受力策，但毫無反應。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leading pair, clear run up inside rail early in straight and challenged over 200m out, soon no extra, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。直路初沿欄望空。二百米處受挑戰。瞬即再無餘力，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) In touch with leaders, headway to challenge 200m out, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。二百米處上前展開挑戰，最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 3 wide in midfield early, 2 wide from 500M, unable to obtain clear run until final 100M, kept on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步時向內斜跑，被碰撞。早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自五百米處起走第二疊。未能望空直至最後一百米。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Raced in touch, hampered briefly when making ground 200m out, stayed on, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。二百米處在追前之際一度受阻礙。末段保持走勢，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, rear of mid-field, didn't travel with much fluency on bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。直路彎走勢欠順。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Sat midfield on the rail, ran on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。以佳勢上前，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide in midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Sat midfield 3 wide, angled out in the Straight, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上向外移出。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Chased leader, under pressure 550m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 追趕領放馬。五百五十米處受催策。保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until final 50M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至最後五十米。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield, 3 wide with no cover, 1-1/4L back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時落後一又四分一個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Soon taken back from the widest barrier travelling wide in last few to straight, made short-lived effort between 400 and 200M, found no extra thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後瞬即留後，直路前居最後數位之內，走外疊。四百米處至二百米處之間一度發力，其後再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Shifted in at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 850M, same margin back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。自八百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Soon taken well back from a wide barrier travelling mainly 4-wide without cover, made headway towards rear inside the 850M, one of the widest into straight, ran home one-paced while hanging out under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居遙遙落後的位置，大多走第四疊，沒有遮擋。八百五十米處略為追前至後列。入直路時為走最外疊的馬匹之一。末段保持同速，在催策下外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Bumped start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, quickly lost place early in home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞。追迫領放馬。直路初迅速失位。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W3W) Settled fairly handy on the rail, moved away from the fence 500M out, looked a chance at the 200M, boxed on well nevertheless.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W3W) 居好位，走內欄。五百米處移離內欄。二百米處看似有力一爭。以佳勢力拼到底。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced behind midfield on the inside, made contact near 600M, saved ground on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened and eased final 50M. (See Racing Incidents.)
Blood in mouth.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，居中間之後位置，走內疊。接近六百米處時發生觸碰。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再加速。最後五十米轉弱，收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
口內有血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never travelled. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。沿途走勢欠順。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Not far off early stages gradually drifting backward to midfield over 700M out, folded up quickly after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W2W2W) 早段落後領先馬匹不遠。七百米處逐漸墮居中間位置。入直路後迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Raced close up, pushed up to challenge leader 150m out, bumped with that rival when shifting right final 100m, edged ahead near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。一百五十米處受推策上前挑戰領放馬。最後一百米在向內斜跑之際與該駒互相碰撞。接近終點時取得領先，勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leader on rail, baulked for a run until the 300M after straightening, quickened to hold every chance only to be overshadowed final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。入直路後受困直至三百米處。加速，一度極具爭勝機會，僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Made contact at start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, still well back on turn, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上略為追前。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 3-year-old gelding, by Hanseatic out of the Snitnel mare Maguli. Horses by the same sire include Happy Pegasus and Bullish Nova. This fellow was given three trials for three wins in Hong Kong. He made all to win by a short-head, under pressure over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he made all to win by 1/2L, under a hold over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 3. He looks a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Hanseatic之後，在港同父馬包括「丙午傳奇」及「牛精新星」等駒，生母出自「犀利時」(Snitzel)。抵港後三次試閘全勝。10月23日出試從化草地1000米，早段領放，末段力策下以短馬頭位之先勝出。最近11月3日出試田泥1200米，早段領放，末段按韁下以半個馬位之先勝出。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Needs Further out of the Good Journey mare Freedom Road. Horses by the same sire include Brownneedsfurther and He Was Me. The fellow was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and finished sixth, beaten by 5Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 3. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: Needs Further之後，在港同父馬包括「星辰千帥」及「劍無情」等駒，生母出自Good Journey。抵港後試閘三次。最近11月3日出試田泥1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬五個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Out with rest, positioned 2 wide in midfield, made contact near 500M, angled out early in straight, unable to obtain clear run until 200M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。接近五百米處時與對手互相觸碰。直路早段向外移出。未能望空直至二百米處，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W6W) Waited with towards rear, raced wide throughout without cover, pushed along widest into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W6W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W) Settled behind midfield, checked shortly after the start, failed to travel thereafter, could not make ground (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久勒避，居中間之後位置，其後走勢欠順。未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, angled out into the straight, made good progress under whip, nearest at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時向外移出。在鞭策下追前頗多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, responded well when asked over the final 150M, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。最後一百五十米對催策反應良佳。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped to last early despite ridden along, made headway on rail after first 200M to reach 8th towards rear shortly afterwards, snuck up on inside in straight reaching within 2L of pace briefly 200M out, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 儘管受催策，但於早段墮居包尾位置。過了首二百米後沿欄追前，其後不久進佔後列的第八位。直路上追前，走內疊。二百米處一度落後領放馬不逾兩個馬位，瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, inconvenienced near 500M, 9 lengths or so back turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。接近五百米處時受妨礙。入直路時落後約九個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W3W2W3W) Tracked leader, failed to respond passing 250M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W3W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。跑過二百五十米處時對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W5W) Sat towards the rear, unable to quickened. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W5W) 居後列。未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast(+) (4W2W2W) Settled worse than midfield, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
(Jockey dropped right rein at 250M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速(+)(4W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。走勢尚可。末段穩步追前。
（於二百五十米處騎師右邊韁繩脫手。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於二百五十米處騎師右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W2W) Sat behind midfield, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W2W) 居中間之後位置。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped start, trapped wide in midfield early, moved closer after passing 850M, positioned 3 wide, a length back in the middle stages, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時被碰撞，早段居中間位置，走外疊。跑過八百五十米處後追近。中段落後一個馬位，走第三疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Jumped cleanly, settled ahead of midfield never far off from leaders, quickened up well in the straight to chase eventual winner. Lost 3rd spot late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘俐落，居中間之前位置，從未遠離領先馬匹。直路上加速良佳，追趕頭馬。末段失去季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Moderately away, raced 3 wide slightly behind midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, showed some response early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初對催策略為交出反應。一百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Tracked pace, no extra and losing ground when becoming unbalanced 50m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;跟隨領放馬。五十米處在失去平衡之際再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield, traveled okay, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走勢尚可。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Raced in touch, good headway to challenge leader 100m out, held final 50m but clear of remainder.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。以佳勢上前，一百米處挑戰領放馬。最後五十米落後，但拋離其他對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, closed off nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Hampered leaving stalls, recovered to race mid-division, one paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時受阻礙，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field, pushed along over 300m out, no impression, including after switched off rail 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。三百米處受推策。一百米處移離內欄後毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Crowded on jumping, raced in 2nd, a length or so back, peaked 300M, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時受擠迫，居第二位，落後約一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced 3 wide, 4 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，落後約四個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎落後相同距離。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Began awkwardly and lost ground, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader, hard ridden after passing 300M but only showed limited response, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;出閘笨拙及失地，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位。跑過三百米處後受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持同速至終點。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced at rear on the inside, similar position on turn, showed some response early in straight, no clear run near 200M, made no progress final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎位置相若。直路初對催策略有反應。接近二百米處時未能望空。最後一百五十米毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, shuffled back to last rounding Home Turn, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。轉直路彎時墮居包尾位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W2W3W) Hampered 1300M out before settling in last few on rail, went wide for a run entering home straight, ran on under pressure down the centre of the track to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W2W3W) 千三米處受阻礙，其後居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時移出外疊取位。末段在跑道中央受催策上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in midfield in 6th within 5L off the pace, went wide for a run into straight but could only run home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間第六位，落後領放馬不逾五個馬位。入直路時走外疊取位，但末段僅保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled not far off on rail, drifted some 4L off the pace in 5th about 1200M out, slightly closer into home straight, fought on under pressure to reach 2.5L 2nd 100M out but without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 落後領先馬匹不遠，走內欄。約千二米處居第五位，落後領放馬約四個馬位。入直路時略為追近。在催策下力拼，一百米處進佔第二位，落後兩個半馬位，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat rear, switched out at the Turn, lay in in the Straight, not much impression made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。直路上內閃。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Broke well settling towards rear, 3-wide behind midfield early in back straight before gaining closer to within 4L of pace briefly 700M out, soon drifted some 5L back to 8th onto home bend, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居後列。對面直路早段居中間之後位置，走第三疊。七百米處追近，一度落後領放馬不逾四個馬位。開始轉直路彎時瞬即墮退至第八位，落後約五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W3W3W) Inconvenienced shortly after start, raced at rear on the inside, 2 wide from 700M, very wide turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W3W3W) 起步後不久受妨礙，居包尾位置，走內疊。自七百米處起走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上超越部分已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W2W3W) Slow to begin, raced at the tail of the field over 10Ls off the fast pace, had big task in hand 400M, made up some ground without troubling the leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W2W3W) 出閘緩慢，居馬群尾列，落後步速甚快的領放馬逾十個馬位。四百米處落後甚多。略為追前，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, held up and never able to be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段受困，從未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Impeded leaving stalls, held up last, had to wait for run turning into home straight, twice short of room when trying to improve in home straight, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時受阻，留居包尾位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路上在嘗試推進之際兩度空位不足。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) From draw 3 dropped back to race near last, kept to inside throughout, closed off quite well to go 2nd close home without troubling the winner. (Jockey fined for returning 3 lbs overweight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，墮後至接近包尾位置。沿途走內疊。末段衝刺頗佳，接近終點時進佔第二位，但未能威脅頭馬。（騎師因返回覆磅時超磅三磅而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, not fully extended.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。未能望空直至一百米處。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed no early pace and settled to be the last few on the rail, briefly held up in the last 100M, travelled strongly to the line, did not disgrace at all.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 欠缺前速，居最後數位之內，走內欄。最後一百米一度受困。以勁勢衝刺至終點。表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Driven along and outpaced early stages, in rear, ridden along 400m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 早段受催策，但未能跟上步速，居後列。四百米處受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide in midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Pushed on to chase leader in a fast run race, struggled to keep up from 500M, already beaten top of straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 在快步速下受推策，追趕領放馬。自五百米處起未能保持走勢。直路初已洩氣潰敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace out wide, improved to press leader 900m out, weakened quickly home straight, tight of room 250m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊。九百米處上前追逼領放馬。直路上迅速轉弱，二百五十米處空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Made contact at start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, there to turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, keen early, headway from 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。早段搶口。自三百米處起追前。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start and unbalanced, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞及失去平衡，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Settled in last few for rails run from a wide barrier, commenced move entering home straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，居最後數位之內，走內欄。入直路時開始上前。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, ridden top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W) Waited with towards rear, raced keenly throughout, dropped to last place top of home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。直路初墮退至包尾位置，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Across from widest draw to press leader, ridden along 300m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W3W) Sat on pace, traveled smoothly, made steady progress over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W3W) 居前列，走勢暢順。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Made contact at start, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 起步時被觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Took up running on rail over 1300M out, increased tempo early in back straight kicking over 2.5L clear, came back to the field rounding home bend, folded up quickly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 千三米處取得領先，走內欄。對面直路初加速帶離逾兩個半馬位。轉直路彎時被馬群追上。直路上迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, unable to improve position, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。未能追前。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped on jumping, driven forward to hold a position ahead of midfield, ran home one paced, soon out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，受催策上前，居中間之前位置。末段保持同速，瞬即再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Held up from wide draw, left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後。最後三百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, made some late headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Raced wide towards rear, lost position early in home straight, well held final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走外疊。直路早段失位。最後二百米遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat near the rear on the rail, made some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Sat at the rear, never a threat
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Settled wide in well back from the widest barrier, trailed the field rounding home bend and into straight, ran past well-beaten runners closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 自最外檔出閘後遙居於後，走外疊。轉直路彎及入直路時尾隨馬群。末段超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W4W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out approaching 600M, 3 lengths or so back turning in, finished off strongly, won by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。趨近六百米處時向外移出。入直路時落後約三個馬位。末段衝刺強勁，以短距離之先獲勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Slowly away, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, passed plenty of field but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。超越不少對手，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, settled behind mid, no clear running in the Straight, not fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。直路上未能望空。未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Held up from high draw, stayed on under pressure final 200m, not reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留後。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢。未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 700m out, good headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置。七百米處開始上前，走外疊。直路彎追前甚多。直路上持續上前。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back, 3 wide from 500M, a length or so back turning in, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。自五百米處起走第三疊。入直路時落後約一個馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先，保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W3W) Wide early, tracked pace, challenged and every chance from 200m out, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W3W) 早段走外疊，跟隨領放馬。自二百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Tracked leader, pushed along over 400m out, soon lost position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受推策，其後瞬即失位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W3W) Wide throughout, raced close up and keen, upsides leaders turning into home straight, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 沿途走外疊，緊隨領先馬匹，搶口。轉入直路時上前追迫領先馬匹。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W3W4W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, made some headway from the 500M, gave ground final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起略為追前。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W) Sat near the rear on the rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初在催策下反應平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Mid-field, one paced under pressure home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。直路上在催策下保持同速。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Outpaced towards rear of mid-field from halfway, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自半程起被拋離，居中間之後位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, never involved. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear, 2 away from the stands' rail, switched to the middle track after passing 400M, no clear run until approaching 150M, finished off strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走外欄第三疊。跑過四百米處後移至跑道中央。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Keen early, settled towards rear, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 早段搶口，居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, forced to steady 1400m out, tight for room 400m out, switched in against rail for clear run 100m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。千四米處被迫收慢。四百米處受緊迫。一百米處切入內欄以望空。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, traveled ungenerously at the early stages in the box-seat, fail to quicken at the straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般。早段居包廂位置，走勢欠順。直路上未能加速。（ 見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Mid-field, headway wide back straight, chased leaders into home straight, no extra final 75m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置。對面直路上上前，走外疊。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。最後七十五米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W5W) Sat towards rear, raced wide, gave ground quickly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居後列，走外疊。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W4W) In rear, pushed along and wide turning into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W4W) 居後列。轉入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W3W3W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, had trouble finding clear running early in the Straight, stayed on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路初未能望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, ridden along to lead, lay out over the concluding stages, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙。在催策下取得領先。末段外閃，保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead in the middle stages, kept on well in straight despite shifting out, won by a neck. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。中段輕鬆領放。直路上儘管向外斜跑，但仍保持佳勢，以一馬頸位之先勝出。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Travelled mainly 3-wide with cover in midfield, slightly inconvenienced over 200M out, fought on steadily closing stages without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 大多居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。二百米處略受妨礙。末段持續力拼，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled off midfield on the rail, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Waited with towards rear, wide final bend, stayed on well and made up several places final 150m, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎走外疊。最後一百五十米保持佳勢，追前數位。過終點時最為接近。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W4W) Moderately away, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W4W) 出閘普通，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Awkward start and lost ground, outpaced early stages, still in last place into home straight, eye-catching headway from rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，早段未能跟上步速。入直路時仍居包尾位置。末段自後列以悅目走勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride at the rear, 7Ls to make up 400M, made some progress without posing serious threat to the leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，留力候上。四百米處落後七個馬位。末段略為追前，但未能真正威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W3W) In rear after slowly away, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on strongly final 100m to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W3W) 出閘緩慢，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後一百米衝刺強勁，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response in straight, kept on same pace to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時與一駒互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應平平。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Restrained to race in midfield along the fence, was held up over the home turn when pace quickened, closed off fairly when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎步速加快時受困。末段在催策下衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, ridden top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策，未能推進。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Pariah out of the Sepoy mare Absolutlypositivly. Horses by the same sire include Lucky Planet and Enjoy Golf. This fellow was given four trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and finished third, beaten by 2-1/2Ls, under the whip over 1000m on turf in Conghua on September 21. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fourth, beaten by 2-3/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「草根級」(Pariah)之後，在港同父馬包括「幸運星球」及「快樂高球」等駒，生母出自「印度戰士」(Sepoy)。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。9月21日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段鞭策下跑第三名，落後頭馬2.5個馬位。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬2.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Hellbent out of the Carlton House mare Décor. Horses by the same sire include Invincible Ibis and Robot Lucky Star. He was given three trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and finished second, beaten by 3/4L, under slight pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and finished second, beaten by a head, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on November 2. He looks like a player here at thef asking.
formguide.comments_chi: 「不惜代價」(Hellbent)之後，在港同父馬包括「白鷺金剛」及「官金騏」等駒，生母出自「嘉登行宮」(Carlton House)。抵港後三次試閘兩次上名。10月23日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。最近11月2日出試從化草地1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頭位。初出有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat off pace 1 off the stand's rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居領放馬之後，走外欄第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly from the widest barrier and soon dropped to last few, raced keenly behind runners 900M out, shifted wide for a run into straight, found nothing.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自大外檔出閘笨拙，瞬即墮居最後數位之內。九百米處在馬匹之後搶口。入直路時移出外疊取位，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, 1-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Away well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位，直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱，跑獲季軍。
