runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; Shifted out at start, raced prominently on the stands' rail, hard ridden approaching 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;起步時向外斜跑，居前列，走外欄。趨近三百米處時受力策。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 200M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬之後，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百米處取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field with cover, ridden top of home straight, ran on well final 200m and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路初受催策。最後二百米走勢良佳，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away well, tracked leaders on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速。跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。直路上保持佳勢，取得亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made some minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat towards the rear, hung out and never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列。外閃，從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast(+) (4W2W3W) Held up from wide draw, still last top of home straight when short of room briefly, stayed on between horses.
(Jockey dropped whip at 100M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速(+)(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，留後。直路初仍居包尾位置，一度空位不足。在馬匹之間保持走勢。
（騎師於一百米處跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W) Away with them, sat right behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 300M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，跟隨領放馬，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。三百米處望空。末段保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Chased leader, challenged and every chance top of home straight, stayed on and lost second close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追趕領放馬。直路初展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。保持走勢。接近終點時失去亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover near midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier, positioned one-out-one-back rounding home bend, came under pressure upon straightening but faded inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，受催策上前。轉直路彎時落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時受催策，但最後一百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Behind after badly hampered leaving stalls, still in last place and plenty to do turning into home straight, stayed on final 300m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時嚴重受阻礙，其後居後列。轉入直路時仍居包尾位置，落後甚遠，最後三百米保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Clean jump, raced 2 wide better than midfield, a length or so back turning in, took the lead approaching 200M, peaked and headed 150M, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘俐落，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約一個馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Settled towards rear in 9th on rail, saved ground turning in for home reaching within 3L of leaders in 7th entering straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列第九位，走內欄。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。入直路時居第七位，落後領先馬匹不逾三個馬位。最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, sat towards rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。從未構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Slow to begin, raced at rear on the stands' rail, unable to obtain clear run final 400M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;出閘緩慢，居後列，走外欄。最後四百米未能望空。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Chased leaders along the inside, struggled to keep up passing 400M, gave further ground in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 追趕領先馬匹，走內疊。跑過四百米處時難以跟上對手。末段進一步墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Driven along and outpaced early stages, detached halfway out, ridden out to finish, little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段受催策，未能跟上步速。半程時被拋離。被力策至終點。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, sat on pace 2 wide, ridden over 300m out, soon no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居前列，走第二疊。三百米處受催策，但瞬即毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide with cover in midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 3 lengths back turning in, showed limited response in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。中段搶口。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上對催策略有反應。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, settled ahead of midfield along the inside, failed to run on when asked top of the straight. Never a threat. (Jockey : his mount was reluctant to improve between runners during the race.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路初受催策時未能追前。從未能構成威脅。（騎師表示，坐騎陣上不願在馬匹之間推進。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled just worse than midfield on rail, baulked for a run after straightening, obtained clear run over 150M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。入直路後受困。一百五十米處望空。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) In rear after slow start, some headway under pressure but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。在催策下略為追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Made running to straight setting a moderate pace, soon weakened after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 直路前以中等步速領放。入直路後瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced close up against rail, pushed along 300m out, no extra final 150m.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。三百米處受推策。最後一百五十米再無餘力。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by a length turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Always thereabouts settling one back on rail behind leader cum eventual winner over 800M out, fought on under pressure but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 沿途居啣接位置。八百米處落後領放馬兼頭馬一個馬位，走內欄。在催策下力拼，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, ridden along to lead, traveled comfortably, led all the way to score (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速。受催策，取得領先，走勢暢順。一放到底，取得勝利。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, angled out 350M, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。三百五十米處向外移出。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W2W) Sat towards the rear, made good late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W2W) 居後列。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear, 8 lengths back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十一檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後八個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Tracked pace, perfectly placed 400m out, unable to quicken, faded final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處居好位。其後未能加速，最後二百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Settled towards rear, gained closer to 7th over 4L back inside the 800M, 3-wide rounding home bend and widest into straight, kept on steadily without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居後列。八百米處追近至第七位，落後逾四個馬位。轉直路彎時走第三疊，入直路時走最外疊。保持穩勢，未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Waited with in rear, headway and in touch with leaders when running out of room under 150m out, unable to be ridden out after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。上前，一百五十米處空位不足之際跟隨領先馬匹，但其後未能受力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Jumped okay, settled at the rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 出閘尚可，居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide towards rear, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, no clear run approaching 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。趨近一百五十米處時未能望空。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon recovered to just worse than midfield on rail after moderate start, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通後瞬即恢復走勢，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Blundered shortly after the start, sat towards rear, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久失蹄，居後列。從未能構成威脅。(見競賽事件報告。)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Shifted out abruptly at start, trapped wide in midfield, hung out after passing 700M, dropped to rear on turn, weakened early in straight, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時急促向外斜跑，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後外閃。直路彎墮居後列。直路初轉弱。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, difficult to settle in the early stages, found rail near 800M, 3-1/2L back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 躍出時被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。早段難以穩定走勢。接近八百米處時移入內欄。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後二百米轉弱。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon led, controlled race from the front, pressed on 300m out, never looked like being caught.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 瞬即領先，在領放下主宰步速。三百米處受追迫，但從未看似能被追及。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact at start, raced prominently on the inside, there to turn, kept on well until final 100M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居前列，走內疊。直路彎前居相同位置。保持佳勢至一百米處，最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slow away and crowded at the start, switched to the middle part of track 300M out, stayed on fairly well inside final 200M, went third towards finish (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，受擠迫。三百米處移至跑道中央。最後二百米保持不俗走勢。趨近終點時跑入季席。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Challenged for the lead 3 wide, kept on nicely to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 爭奪領先，走第三疊。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Out in line, sent forward to race prominently on the outside, 1/2L back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to lead, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。保持佳勢，跑入亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked pace, stuck to task under pressure home straight, lacked speed to challenge winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上在催策下持續力拼，但未能增速以挑戰頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, took the lead 200M, headed 150M, kept on well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。二百米處取得領先。一百五十米處被超越。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, 1/2L back turning in, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well to hold off the challengers late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。趨近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，力拒對手挑戰掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Ridden along in the early stages to be one out one back, stuck on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段受催策，居第二疊第二位。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Disputed lead between horses, nothing extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 在馬匹之間爭奪領先。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, took the lead 950M, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually final 50M, finished 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。九百五十米處取得領先，入直路時領先四分三個馬位。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped awkwardly and bumped, took the lead, challenged by rival after passing 400M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙及發生碰撞，取得領先。跑過四百米處後受對手挑戰。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W2W2W) Wide early, improved to race outside of leader halfway, stuck to task under pressure but outpaced by winner final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W2W2W) 早段走外疊。半程時推進至領放馬外側。在催策下持續力拼，但最後一百五十米被頭馬拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W3W) Mid-field, sustained run from 300m out, led final 100m, won decisively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W3W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起持續追前。一百米處取得領先，以出色姿態勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Bumped and lost balance shortly after leaving stalls, raced in rear, chased along final bend, ran on strongly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘後不久被碰撞，失去平衡，居後列。直路彎追趕對手。最後二百米走勢強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, raced without cover throughout, gave ground quickly in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟前競跑，走第三疊，沿途沒有遮擋。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced behind midfield on the inside, unbalanced near 600M, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。接近六百米處時失去平衡。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, positioned a length behind the leader on the inside, saved ground throughout, showed some response early in straight, peaked on run 100M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，落後領放馬一個馬位，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策略有反應。一百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the outside, 2 wide on turn, made some progress early in straight, no clear run final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎走第二疊。直路早段略為追前。最後二百米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Bounced away awkwardly and checked when bumped, made some headway from the tail of the field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，在被碰撞之際勒避。末段自馬群尾列略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Travelled very wide without cover in rear of midfield, yielded ground rounding home bend, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時墮退。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Prominent, took up running over 800M out setting a sound pace, held narrow lead until headed about 250M out, folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，八百米處帶頭，以快步速領放。以短距離領先，直至二百五十米處被超越。迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, towards the rear 6Ls back, failed to run on in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列，落後六個馬位。直路上未能上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start along the rail to share early pace, crossed by race leaders and lost position 600M out, some 3L back in 4th rounding home bend, faded steadily in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步普通，瞬即恢復走勢，早段跟上步速，走內欄。六百米處被領先馬匹橫越，失位。轉直路彎時居第四位，落後約三個馬位。直路上逐漸力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W4W) Ridden early, 4-wide without cover just over 2L back in 5th 1000M out before taken 3L back but remained without cover midway down back straight, dropped tamely out of contention inside final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W4W) 早段受催策。一千米處居第五位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。其後在對面直路中段留後三個馬位，但仍然沒有遮擋。最後二百五十米乏力墮退，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, settled midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along final bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped on terms and utilised his early pace to take up the front-running position, run ended at 200m, soon headed and weakened considerably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，利用前速領放。二百米處無以為繼，瞬即被超越，嚴重轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded at start, raced in touch with leaders, driven 400m out, short of room final 150m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。最後一百五十米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Tracked pace two wide, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (8W1W1W) Used plenty of petrol to take up the leading position, stuck on ok considering the circumstances (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(8W1W1W) 花了不少氣力以取得領先。在此情況下走勢尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (4W3W3W) Caught wide, forward move to race outside of leading pair at halfway, challenged and every chance from 200m out, no extra final 50m, just held third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(4W3W3W) 走外疊。半程時上前，居領先兩駒外側。自二百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後五十米再無餘力。僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, commenced move out wide 500m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處開始發力，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, weakened quickly over 200m out.
(Jockey dropped whip at 150M.)
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。二百米處迅速轉弱。
（於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
（心律不正常。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於一百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division against far rail, briefly tight for room when under pressure 300m out, stayed on but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，走外欄。三百米處受催策時一度受緊迫。末段保持走勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked pace, tight for room briefly behind rival 200m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。二百米處在對手之後一度空位不足。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Pressed leader, keen, checked briefly 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 追迫領放馬，搶口。二百米處一度勒避。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to lead, kicked 400m out, headed by winner 150m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘後受催策，取得領先。四百米處加速。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Showed good speed to lead, headed by winner halfway out, weakened final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;前速甚快，取得領先。半程時被頭馬超越。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Chased leaders, ridden along 350m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;追趕領先馬匹。三百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Tracked leaders, unable to hold position halfway, flattened out final 200m.
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;緊隨領先馬匹。半程時未能保持位置。最後二百米洩氣。
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。從未構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Tracked pace, struggling to hold position 400m out, weakened.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處難以保持位置。其後轉弱。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W) Away quickly from gate 7 and landed on the fence stalking the leader, switched course when slightly ran out of racing room 200M out, one-paced to the finish (See Incident Report).
Lame in right front leg.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W) 自第七檔出閘迅速，沿欄跟隨領放馬。二百米處空位略為不足時轉移跑線。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）
右前腿不良於行。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W) Settled in front midfield 2 wide, switched out in the Straight, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leading pair, stuck to task under pressure and never far away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。在催策下保持走勢。從未遠離領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Began awkwardly and made contact, taken back to race behind midfield on outer, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，與對手互相觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled on pace 2 wide, kept on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。保持不俗走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced prominently, 2 wide, weakened from 500M, eased early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走第二疊。自五百米處起轉弱。直路早段收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Crowded and bumped at start, raced in rear, still in rear top of home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居後列。直路初仍居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Raced in rear after checked 1100m out, under pressure from 700m out to hold position, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 千一米處勒避，其後居後列。自七百米處起受催策以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, bumped 1000m out, under pressure on bend to chase leaders, left behind home straight, well beaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。一千米處發生碰撞。直路彎在催策下追趕領先馬匹。直路上被拋離，所負甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Taken back from the outside barrier, sat towards the rear on the rail, made minor headway late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W1W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。
患有喘鳴症。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, difficult to settle throughout, made contact 400M, showed limited response in straight, steadied near 100M, weakened gradually close home. (See Racing Incidents.)
Roarer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 5-year-old gelding, by Pierro out of the Dubawi mare	 Chortle. Horses by the same sire include Perfect Pairing and Furore. This fellow had fifteen starts for two wins (a maiden over 2000m on Synthetic, and a handicap over 1550m) and six placings. He was given four trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and finished seventh, beaten by 7-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 10. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「比亞路」(Pierro)之後，在港同父馬包括「幸運同行」及「添滿意」等駒，生母出自「杜拜威」(Dubawi)。來港前在澳洲十五戰得兩勝六位，頭馬包括一場2000米膠沙地從未勝出馬賽，及一場1550米讓磅賽。抵港後試閘四次。最近11月10日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第七名，落後頭馬7.25個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W4W) Away well, raced better than midfield but trapped wide, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took effect.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路初轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, no clear run early in straight, cleared after passing 300M, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路初未能望空。跑過三百米處後望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Bumped start, raced towards rear on the inside, angled out 500M, 6-1/2L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後六個半馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat towards rear on the inside, 5 lengths back turning in, made no impression in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。走內疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W2W) Slightly slow out settling in last few, baulked for a run most of the way in home straight, produced late impression inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W2W) 出閘稍慢，居最後數位之內。直路上大部分途程受困。最後五十米追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled in last few on rail, switched out early in home straight but soon ran out of room inside the 200M, made no impression thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居最後數位之內，走內欄。直路早段向外移出，但二百米處瞬即空位不足。其後毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground throughout, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Jumped fairly, ended up racing in a rearward spot 6-7Ls off leader, ran on moderately in the straight but not able to trouble leaders.
(Jockey dropped whip at 550M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘一般，居後列，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。直路上略為追前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。
（於五百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於五百五十米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W4W) In rear after crowded at start, taken wider final bend, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列。直路彎移出較外疊。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled towards the rear on the rail after a sluggish start, travelled okay throughout, failed to show his usual turn of foot with good pace up front.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，走內欄。沿途走勢尚可。賽事步速偏快，未能展現慣常加速力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W3W) Settled in midfield 3-wide without cover, yielded ground from home bend.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。自直路彎起墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W2W) From draw 12 moved forward to take up a trailing position behind leaders, drifted back to midfield when leaders went fast middle stages, failed to finish off in the straight
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘後上前，佔取領先馬匹之後有遮擋的位置。中段在領先馬匹加速之際墮居中間位置。直路上未能以勁勢加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W3W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier before shifting back to behind midfield some 7L off the pace in back straight, renewed effort 3-wide rounding home bend and wider into straight, ran on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。對面直路上留居中間之後位置，落後領放馬約七個馬位。轉直路彎時重新發力，走第三疊。入直路時走更外疊。走勢平穩，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W2W) Bumped and unbalanced shortly after start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, peaked early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
(Lame in right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞及失去平衡，居第二位，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。末段保持穩勢。
（右後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W2W2W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 7 lengths or so back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W2W2W4W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約七個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat on pace, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Raced in rear after bumped leaving stalls, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，其後居後列。入直路時須等待空位出現。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Waited with in rear, ridden top of home straight, tight for room 200m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策。二百米處受緊迫，從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Chased leader, disputed led middle stages, ridden top of home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 追趕領放馬。中段爭奪領先。直路初受催策。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W1W2W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, responded well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 居前列。走勢良佳。在鞭策下反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Settled in the last few 3 wide, niggled along to improve out wide 600M out, carried wider rounding for home, faded over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 居最後數位之內，走第三疊。六百米處受催策以推進，走外疊。轉直路彎時被帶出更外疊。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider on turn, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速， 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎走更外疊。直路初對催策略有反應，一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Never far off, baulked briefly behind runners early in home straight, could only keep on steadily without quickening in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 從未遠離領先馬匹。直路初一度在馬群之後受困。末段僅能保持穩勢，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, soon headed by winner 150m out, stayed on well for a clear third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先，瞬即在一百五十米處被頭馬超越。保持佳勢，帶離餘駒，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen early, pushed along wide into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled on pace 2 wide, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。保持走勢，最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (4W1W2W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier to 2nd chasing leader on rail in back straight, fanned wide for a run turning for home and hit the front 200M out only to be overhauled inside final 60M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(4W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前。對面直路上居第二位，沿欄追趕領放馬。轉入直路時向外移出以望空。二百米處取得領先。僅在最後六十米被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced in midfield, left flat footed when the race got serious from 400M. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。自四百米處起馬群加速時停滯不前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W) Raced 3-wide without cover just better than midfield, weakened out of contention inside final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W) 居中間稍前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後二百五十米轉弱，再無爭逐機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield, 5 lengths or so back, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，落後約五個馬位。直路上追前頗多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled at the rear on the rail, 2 wide in the turn, made good ground from the back in last 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置，走內欄。直路彎走第二疊。最後一百五十米自後列追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (6W3W3W) From wide draw obtained a midfield position along the 3-path, ran on mildly over final 300M for 3rd. Not reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(6W3W3W) 自大外檔出閘後居中間位置，走第三疊。最後三百米走勢普通，跑入季席。未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Jumped with them, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths or back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along on bend, some late gains but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策。末段略為追前，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Dropped back from a wide draw, held up in last 6-7Ls off the pace, picked up nicely in the straight and made nice inroads under top weight 135lb to take 3rd just before line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬六至七個馬位。直路上加速良佳，在負頂磅一百三十五磅下追前甚多，過終點前跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, raced in rear, driven along 400m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。四百米處受催策。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W1W) From wide draw taken back to last and was given a waiting ride, 8Ls behind leader 400M, closed off fastest under top weight but couldn't be ridden out final 50M when held up between rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留居包尾位置，早段未受催策。四百米處落後領放馬八個馬位。在負頂磅下末段衝刺最快，但最後五十米在對手之間受困時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Restrained to race towards the rear, 4-5Ls off leader 400M, closed off fastest to claim 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 受約束，居後列。四百米處落後領放馬四至五個馬位。末段衝刺最快，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 400m out, ran on well to close on leader but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。四百米處開始發力，走外疊。以佳勢追近領放馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden along 300m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Caught racing wide behind leaders and had no cover in the middle stages, driven to challenge for the lead 400M, began to weaken 150M, checked 100M losing momentum. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走外疊。中段沒有遮擋。四百米處在催策下爭奪領先。一百五十米處開始轉弱。一百米處勒避，失去步韻。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, angled out to make run 500m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處向外移出取位。衝刺強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (5W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly to make up a lot of ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。以勁勢上前，追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Chased leaders on jumping from draw 1, gave good response turning home, stormed to the lead nearing 100M winning decisively.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，追趕領先馬匹。轉直路彎時對催策反應良佳。接近一百米處時以勁勢取得領先，以漂亮姿態勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Crowded shortly after the start and settled further back in the field than intended, closed off final 400M fastest from a position behind midfield to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居較預期為後的位置。最後四百米自中間之後位置展開衝刺，為最快一駒，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders against rail, short of room on bend, ridden top of home straight, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路彎空位不足。直路初受催策。末段保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W5W) Reserved in a rearward spot 6-7Ls off leader in a genuinely run race, pushed along 500M, ran home well enough but had too much to make up on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W5W) 留居後列，落後領放馬六至七個馬位，賽事步速偏快。五百米處受推策，末段衝刺良佳，但已落後領先馬匹甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, driven middle stages, switched for clear run top of home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。中段受催策。直路初轉換跑線以望空。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Waited with towards rear, ridden top of home straight, ran on well final 200m, beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初受催策。最後二百米走勢良佳，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W) Unable to slot in from draw 7, caught racing wide no cover behind midfield, responded mildly to pressure passing 300M, stayed on without posing serious threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W) 自第七檔出閘後未能切入內疊，居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。跑過三百米處時對催策反應普通。末段保持走勢，未能對領先馬匹構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, briefly impeded 1100m out, angled wide for clear run into home straight, strong run to lead final 50m, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。千一米處一度受阻礙。入直路時向外移出以望空。走勢強勁，五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, taken wider on bend, gave ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。最後一百五十米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, failed to make any progress thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空，其後未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders against rail, travelled smoothly into home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時走勢暢順。三百米處轉換跑線以望空，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced in 3rd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well in straight to take a place, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第三位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但一直落後頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Three wide in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Ridden forward from the widest barrier to be 4-wide without cover in midfield, gave ground steadily final bend dropping to last over 200M out.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(5W3W4W) 自最外檔出閘，在催策下上前，居中間位置，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎逐漸墮退。二百米處墮居包尾位置。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Commenced to race keenly early stages and ended up leading reluctantly, didn't respond to riding in the home straight, weakened rapidly. (Trainer - not suited by being ridden in the lead / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 早段開始搶口，被迫帶頭。直路上對催策毫無反應。末段迅速轉弱。（練馬師表示，此駒在領放下不利發揮。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Out in line, sent forward to raced prominently on the outside, there to turn, peaked 250M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前，居前列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。二百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, travelled in mid-pack along the fence, kept on steadily in the straight without posing threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內欄。直路上保持穩勢，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Not hurried after the jump and settled towards the rear, had big task in hand 400M (10L), made limited progress only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 躍出後未受催策，居後列。四百米處落後甚遠（十個馬位）。末段僅能略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Three wide in rear, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊。未能望空直至一百五十米處。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Began well, dropped back to a midfield position on settling, ran on fairly passing 400M, not ridden out late sages when awkward placed behind rivals.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘迅速，墮居中間位置。跑過四百米處時走勢一般。末段在對手之後處於窘境之際未能被力策。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Always prominent, just over 2L off the pace into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 一直居前列。入直路時落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Jumped on terms, raced 3-wide no cover in midfield, kept battling final 300M but unable to quicken. Steadied 50M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。最後三百米持續力拼，但未能加速。五十米處收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走外疊，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider final bend, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。保持佳勢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by King's Legacy out of the Star Witness mare Serenade. Horses by the same sire include Hero Rising and Golden Win. This fellow had one start for one win (a maiden over 1350m). He was given four trials for four placings in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished third, beaten by 2Ls, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 20. In the latest trial, he made the run and finished third, beaten by a neck, under pressure over 1200m AWT Sha Tin on November 5. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: 「王者事蹟」(King's Legacy)之後，在港同父馬包括「喜駿昇星」及「金運齊來」等駒，生母出自「重要證人」(Star Witness)。來港前在澳洲一出一捷，頭馬為一場1350米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後四次試閘四次上名。10月20日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Waited with in rear, raced keenly throughout, still in rear top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。沿途搶口。直路初仍居後列。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Shifted in at start and made contact, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the middle track, hard ridden from 350M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時向內斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，落後領放馬三個馬位，在跑道中央競跑。自三百五十米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; From draw 1 slotted into a midfield position, responded well when driven out 350M, lay in final 300M and ended up towards the far rail. Kept going well to line and not beaten far by the placegetters
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;自第一檔出閘，居中間位置。三百五十米處受力策，反應良佳。最後三百米內閃，靠近內欄競跑。保持佳勢至終點，落後頭三名馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, switched wide for clear run top of home straight, bumped 150m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初移出外疊以望空。一百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。末段保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped fairly, moved up to settle just off leaders, responded well to pressure 300M challenging for the lead, peaked on his run passing 100M and outsprinted by first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘一般，上前居領先馬匹稍後位置。三百米處對催策反應良佳，爭奪領先。跑過一百米處時未能再增速，被首兩名馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (4W3W4W) Started well but settled in mid-field, headway widest on bend, strong run to lead 100m out despite edging right, well on top.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(4W3W4W) 出閘迅速但居中間位置。直路彎上前，走最外疊。衝刺強勁，儘管向內斜跑，但仍在一百米處取得領先。末段穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W3W) Jumped fast, led early stages before taking up a trailing position behind leaders, worked into the race nicely passing 400M, fought hard to the line but was held by winner throughout the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘迅速，早段領先，其後在領先馬匹之後取得遮擋。跑過四百米處時以佳勢上前。力拼至終點，但末段沿途未能追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well from gate 13, tracked leaders on the outside, no cover throughout, showed good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十三檔出閘迅速，跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路上對催策反應良佳，二百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Ridden early to be up with the pace, gradually shifted over 2L back in 5th home bend, angled off rail for a run on straightening but no clear run until about 200M out, quickened well late to snatch 2nd close to finish.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 早段受催策以緊隨領放馬。直路彎逐漸墮居第五位，落後逾兩個馬位。入直路時移離內欄取位，但未能望空直至約二百米處。末段加速良佳。接近終點時跑獲亞軍。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, just one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。末段僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sluggish start, three wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, struggling.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。掙扎上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat on pace 3 from the stands' rail, weakened from the 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列，走外欄第四疊。自三百米處起轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well settling in midfield on rail, badly crowded and dropped quickly out of contention 600M out, never recovered.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處嚴重受擠迫及迅速墮退，再無爭勝機會。從未恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W5W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced near the rear always, failed to pick up in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W5W) 出閘笨拙及失地，沿途居後列。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W2W) Disputed led early stages, pressed leader middle stages, quickened early in home straight to lead 200m out, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W2W) 早段爭奪領先。中段追迫領放馬。直路初加速，二百米處取得領先。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，僅勝。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Across to press leader, quickened early to lead top of home straight, headed 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先。二百米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crossed from wide draw to make running, headed over 200m out, no extra and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，帶頭競跑。二百米處被超越。最後一百米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Settled in midfield along the inside, ran home only fairly from 300M. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內疊。自三百米處起衝刺僅屬一般。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (6W3W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear, 6 lengths or so back, still last turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(6W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列，落後約六個馬位。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders, good headway on bend, strong run in home straight to lead 200m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎追前甚多。直路上衝刺強勁，二百米處取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Mid division, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced towards rear on the outside, 7 lengths or so back, there to turn, made very good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，落後約七個馬位，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W3W) Settled down in second half of the field, closed off final 400M fastest to finish equal 3rd. Nearest line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 居後半馬群中。最後四百米衝刺最快，取得平頭季軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled midfield on the rail, saved ground, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。走內欄節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W5W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly to score
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W5W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (5W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(5W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, switched in for clear run top of home straight, strong run to lead 150m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時走勢暢順。直路初向內移入以望空。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Tracked leader, bumped 1000m out, challenged winner 400m out, ran on well to lead briefly 150m out, headed close home, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。一千米處與對手互相碰撞。四百米處挑戰頭馬。保持佳勢，一百五十米處一度取得領先。接近終點時被超越，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Not the quickest out, settled midfield 3 wide, closed off nicely to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘並非最快，居中間位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide better than midfield, difficult to settle, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, kept on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。難以穩定走勢，大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速，末段保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Heavily bumped out of stalls, ridden along to chase leader, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被大力碰撞，受催策以追趕領放馬。三百米處迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide from 500M, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。自五百米處起走第三疊。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Frosted out of the Snitzel mare Badia. Horses by the same sire include All’s Well and Elite Golf. This fellow had fourteen starts for three wins (including two handicaps over 1250m and 1600m) and five placings. He was given four trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished second, beaten by a neck, under pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 22. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished sixth, beaten by 3-3/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 5. He's a nice horse and could run well here on debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「霜降」(Frosted)之後，在港同父馬包括「亨驥」及「精英高球」等駒，生母出自「犀利時」(Snitzel)。來港前在澳洲十四戰得三勝五位，頭馬包括兩場讓磅賽，途程分別為1250米及1600米。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。10月22日出試田泥1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。最近11月5日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第六名，落後頭馬3.75個馬位。潛質不俗，預計初出會有良好走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, wider turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Went forward, in 3rd spot 1200M, continued to press leader down the back-straight, had nothing left turning home and weakened to last. (Jockey questioned his riding tactics.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 上前。千二米處居第三位。對面直路上持續追迫領放馬。轉直路彎時再無餘力，其後轉弱，包尾而回。（騎師被查詢騎法。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Shifted in and crowded at start, settled in mid-field, under pressure 700m out, stayed on well but no match for front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 起步時向內斜跑，受擠迫，居中間位置。七百米處受催策。末段保持佳勢，但不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Pressed along to be chasing leaders, couldn't quicken with rivals passing 300M, no extra late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 受催策以追趕領先馬匹。跑過三百米處時未能與對手一起加速，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, switched wide 550m out, bumped 350m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。五百五十米處移出外疊。三百五十米處發生碰撞。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Bumped out of stalls, pressed leader, ridden 250m out, strong run to lead final 50m, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，追迫領放馬。二百五十米處受催策。衝刺強勁，最後五十米取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Shared lead early stages before settling down in 3rd, couldn't find extra gear to challenge leaders and was comfortably held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段並排領先，其後居第三位。未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹，始終未能追近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Away in line, maintained a midfield position along the fence, chased steadily final 300M but found a few quicker.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走內欄。最後三百米持續追趕，但速度不及若干對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) From draw 12 eased back to sit at the tail of the field, cut the corner home turn, stayed on down the inside but never looked like getting to first two which finished well clear from the field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，收慢留居包尾位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。其後在內疊保持走勢，但從未看似能追上已帶離馬群的頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Outpaced early stages and settled in 2nd half of the field 5-6Ls off the pace, had the job ahead 400M, closed off mildly but was never a winning hope.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;早段未能跟上步速，居後半馬群，落後領放馬五至六個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠。衝刺普通，從未有望爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Held up in mid-pack along the inside, lay in for most part of the straight, gave limited response only.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 留居中間位置，走內疊。直路上大部分途程內閃，對催策反應僅屬平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W1W1W) From wide draw taken across behind runners, raced at the rear along the inside, was finishing well but got held up between 150M-50M. Would have finished closer.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，在馬群之後切入，居後列，走內疊。衝刺良佳，但一百五十米處至五十米處之間受困。本應可跑得更為接近。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off very strongly, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，衝刺凌厲，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Jumped well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped cleanly from 11, showed good speed to be racing behind leaders, well placed to strike top of straight before keeping on steadily for 4th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十一檔出閘俐落，展現甚快前速，跟隨領先馬匹。直路初居好位，蓄勢待發，其後保持穩勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) Obtained a trailing spot behind leaders, poised to strike top of the straight but the finishing response was only fair, found no extra close home. (Jockey - would derive a fitness benefit from tonight's run.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 居領先馬匹之後，有遮擋。直路初蓄勢待發，但末段在催策下衝刺僅屬一般。接近終點時再無餘力。（騎師表示，坐騎應能從是賽中提升狀態。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled worse than midfield near center, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, ridden top of home straight, forced to steady 150m out, weakened quickly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。一百五十米處被迫收慢。最後一百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W4W) Travelled wide without cover in rear of midfield after beginning from a wide barrier, obtained cover towards rear in 8th inside the 700M, swung wide for a run into straight, ran on down the apparent fast strip to be nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處居後列第八位，取得遮擋。入直路時向外移出以望空。末段沿大外疊追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W2W) Lost considerable ground at start, soon recovered to rear of the field while racing keenly 1000M out, tight behind runners on rail inside the 600M, switched for a run over 200M out producing good late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W2W) 起步時失地甚多。瞬即恢復走勢，居後列，一千米處搶口。六百米處在馬群之後受緊迫，走內欄。二百米處轉換跑線取位，末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W4W) Sat ahead of midfield just over 2Ls off leader, brought wide from 400M, loomed up and fought hard, briefly in front 150M but run ended passing 100M and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W4W) 居中間之前位置，落後領放馬稍逾兩個馬位。自四百米處起移出外疊。其後在力拼下上前。一百五十米處一度取得領先，但跑過一百米處時無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Crowded shortly after start, tracked leaders, travelled strongly final bend to lead top of home straight, stayed on, headed by front three close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎走勢強勁，直路初取得領先。保持走勢，接近終點時被三甲馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W1W) Ridden to take up running 950M out and rails run 800M out, kicked some 2L clear in front rounding home bend, just held off strong challenges in straight to prevail narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W1W) 受催策，九百五十米處取得領先，八百米處移入內欄。轉直路彎時加速帶離約兩個馬位。直路上力拒對手的強勁挑戰，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Caught racing wide in midfield, hung in throughout and responded only fairly in the straight. (Jockey fined for failing to ride out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。沿途內閃，直路上對催策反應僅屬一般。（騎師因未有力策坐騎至終點，表現未能令小組滿意而被罰款。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped only fairly, obtained a position behind midfield, brought wide on straightening but lacked the extra gear to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。入直路時移出外疊，但未能增速挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W2W2W) Began fairly settling in midfield in 6th, switched widest into straight and responded well inside final 250M out to assert authority inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W2W2W) 出閘一般，居中間第六位。入直路時移出最外疊。最後二百五十米對催策反應良佳。最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made running, headed 400m out, weakening when checked 200m out, soon dropped away.
(Irregular heart rhythm.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。四百米處被超越。二百米處在勒避之際轉弱。瞬即墮退。
（心律不正常。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Pressed leader, travelled smoothly to challenge leader top of home straight, ran on well to lead 200m out and hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。走勢暢順，直路初挑戰領放馬。走勢良佳，二百米處取得領先。保持走勢勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Began moderately racing wide behind midfield, keen early stages losing cover briefly at about 850M out, in last few into straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走外疊。早段搶口。約八百五十米處一度失去遮擋。入直路時居最後數位之內。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly, ridden along to lead, kept on fairly well (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，在催策下取得領先。保持不俗走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Fairly away, gradually settled in the last few, angled into the clear wide 450m out, lifted strongly to be 3/4 L outside the winner inside final 150m, unable to bridge the margin further.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘一般，逐漸居最後數位之內。四百五十米處移出外疊望空。衝刺強勁，一百五十米處居頭馬外側，落後四分三個馬位，但未能進一步收窄距離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W5W) Made contact with the right side of its starting gate on jumping, raced at rear, 9 lengths or so back, still 7 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W5W) 躍出時觸碰閘廂右側，居後列，落後約九個馬位。入直路時仍落後約七個馬位。直路上追前頗多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Shifted out shortly after start and made contact, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 起步後不久向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W3W5W) Tracked leaders out wide without cover, improved halfway out, taken very wide into home straight, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W3W5W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊，沒有遮擋。半程時推進。入直路時移出大外疊。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, moved closer on turn, 3 wide turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎追近。入直路時走第三疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat on pace, kept on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列。保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W4W) Sat handy 2 wide, closed off only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W4W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Jumped well then eased back to midfield on settling, steadied 500M losing ground, responded well when asked and made steady progress towards the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後收慢留居中間位置。五百米處收慢，失地。對催策反應良佳，末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Shifted in at start, settled in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on well final 200m to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑。居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W3W) Slowly away, positioned 5 lengths behind the leader on rail, same margin back on turn, angled out 350M, unable to obtain clear run until final 100M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W3W) 出閘緩慢，落後領放馬五個馬位，走內欄。直路彎落後相同距離。三百五十米處向外移出。未能望空直至一百米處。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W) Settled well back in last from a wide barrier, gained one closer on rail 800M out, improving until out of room 150M out, steadied again 50M out, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後遙居包尾位置。八百米處沿欄追前一位。持續推進直至一百五十米處空位不足。五十米處再度收慢，再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, unable to switch 500m out, clear run 200m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。五百米處未能轉換跑線。二百米處望空，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen early stages, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上，早段搶口。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded start, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat at the rear on the rail, no clear run in the Straight, never tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。直路上未能望空。從未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, held up and never tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段受困。從未能施為。
